facets.description: utilities.js line 182: the client-side size check hardcodes 10*1024 instead of reading the per-type Discourse.SiteSettings max_<type>_size_kb limit, so admin-configured limits are ignored
utilities.js line 246: the 413 handler hardcodes 10MB, so the file_too_large alert shows the wrong max_size_kb
Non-image uploads: max_attachment_size_kb is no longer enforced on either side, because the server only downsizes images
